name: HTTP client
description: Send HTTP requests by hand on a page of its own or let agents send them: any method, headers and bodies, saved requests, environments with variables, secrets from the vault, and one searchable history of every request.
integration.summary: Requests to any API by hand or by agents, with a searchable history
integration.example: Send a GET to https://api.github.com/repos/nodejs/node and show me the response
error.badUrl: “{url}” is not an address: it has to start with http:// or https://.
error.badBodyType: That is not a body type. Types: {types}.
error.bodyTooLong: That body is too long: {max} at most.
error.missingVars: Variables with no value: {names}. Give them in the environment, or with the request.
error.badVarName: “{name}” cannot be a variable's name: use letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores.
error.vaultInHost: A vault reference cannot be the host of an address.
error.vaultField: vault://{id} has no single secret field (fields: {fields}): name one as vault://{id}#field.
error.nameTooLong: That name is too long: {max} characters at most.
error.entryNotFound: There is no entry {id} in the history.
error.badCurl: That does not read as a curl command.
error.curlMultipart: File uploads (curl -F) are not supported yet.
failure.local: This computer's own addresses are closed
failure.lan: This host in your network is not allowed yet
failure.local.hint: Requests never go to this computer itself (localhost and the like): the hub's own services live there.
failure.lan.hint: Hosts in your own network are closed until you allow them. Ask an agent to open this host, and answer on its card.
failure.invalid: The request could not be sent
ui.title: HTTP
ui.url: Address, or paste a curl command
ui.pair.name: Name
ui.env.title: Environments
ui.env.name: Name
ui.env.hint: Write {{name}} anywhere in a request and it is filled from the active environment. For a key or a token, put vault://id as the value: the secret stays in the vault.
ui.save.name: Name
ui.ask.entry: Look at this HTTP request with me: {method} {url} (history entry {id}).
ui.ask.draft: Help me with this HTTP request: {method} {url}
ui.empty.history.hint: Send one here, or ask an agent in the chat: every request lands in this list.
ui.empty.saved.hint: Save a request to call it again by name, here or in the chat.
ui.clear.confirm: Remove every request from the history?
ui.response.none: Send the request to see the response here.
ui.response.binary: A binary body of {size}: it is not kept.
ui.response.truncated: The body was longer than what is read and kept: this is its beginning.
ui.widget.gone: This request is no longer in the history.
